result.instructions: Tools for Telzio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which calls did we miss yesterday, and who called?"; "Show me the details and call legs of call abc123, including the price."; "What is on our call queues right now, and which agents are free?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Telzio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run telzio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run telzio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run telzio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. telzio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: telzio_list_call_log
tools.title: List call log
tools.description: List calls from the call log, newest first. Returns at most MaxResults calls per page (default 20); use Offset to page. Telzio API: GET /calls/log.

FromDate.description: Only calls from this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

ToDate.description: Only calls up to this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

Number.description: Only calls on these Telzio numbers (country code, no +).

Tag.description: Only calls with any of these tags.

Offset.description: Start the list at this offset (paging).

tools.name: telzio_get_call
tools.title: Get call details
tools.description: Get one call with its legs, price, hang-up causes, spam score and event timeline. Telzio API: GET /calls/details/{CallUUID}.

CallUUID.description: The CallUUID of the call (from telzio_list_live_calls or telzio_list_call_log).

tools.name: telzio_list_live_calls
tools.title: List live calls
tools.description: List the calls in progress now, with their CallUUIDs. Telzio API: GET /calls/live.

tools.name: telzio_get_account_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: Get the current Telzio account balance in USD. Telzio API: GET /account/balance.

tools.name: telzio_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List all users on the account with their extension, number, admin flag, groups and call-recording setting. Telzio API: GET /users.

tools.name: telzio_list_numbers
tools.title: List phone numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers on the account (NumberID and E.164). Telzio API: GET /numbers.

tools.name: telzio_list_user_groups
tools.title: List user groups
tools.description: List all user groups on the account. Telzio API: GET /groups.

tools.name: telzio_list_call_flows
tools.title: List call flows
tools.description: List all call flows on the account. Telzio API: GET /flows.

tools.name: telzio_list_queues
tools.title: List call queues
tools.description: List all call queues on the account (QueueId and QueueName). Telzio API: GET /queue/all.

tools.name: telzio_get_queue
tools.title: Get call queue
tools.description: Get one call queue with its agents, their current status and the callers now waiting. Telzio API: GET /queue/{QueueId}/view.

tools.name: telzio_list_blacklist
tools.title: List blocked numbers
tools.description: List the numbers on the account's blacklist (blocked callers). Telzio API: GET /blacklist.

tools.name: telzio_hang_up_call
tools.title: Hang up a live call
tools.description: Hang up a live call now. This ends the call for everyone on it. Telzio API: POST /calls/{CallUUID}/hangup.

CallUUID.description: The CallUUID of the call (from telzio_list_live_calls or telzio_list_call_log).

tools.name: telzio_transfer_call
tools.title: Transfer a live call
tools.description: Transfer a live call to another user, extension or external number. Telzio API: POST /calls/{CallUUID}/transfer.

CallUUID.description: The CallUUID of the call (from telzio_list_live_calls or telzio_list_call_log).

Destination.description: The extension, or an E.164 number such as +18889989080, to transfer the call to.

tools.name: telzio_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS
tools.description: Send one SMS from a Telzio number to one recipient. Use only for the account's own direct messages: no bulk or unsolicited sends. Each call sends a new message. Telzio API: POST /sms/send.

From.description: Your Telzio phone number in E.164 format, for example +18889989080.

To.description: The recipient phone number in E.164 format.

prompts.title: Get started with Telzio
prompts.description: What you can do with Telzio here, with example requests to try.
